title: Gym Mirror Progress Shot Consistency Studio

contract.openingPromptExact: I want a saveable, openable Gym Mirror Progress Shot Consistency Studio for tablet and desktop that helps me make comparable gym progress photos with pose, angle, lighting, background cards, privacy crop checks, retake warnings, a session comparison score, and a copyable shoot receipt, without needing to upload images.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide repeatable pose, angle, lighting, background, distance, and timing setup controls without requiring image upload.
Include privacy crop checks and useful retake warnings before a session is accepted.
Calculate a meaningful comparability score from the selected setup and preserve a usable session history.
Provide a copyable shoot receipt that makes the next progress-photo session repeatable.
Produce one complete self-contained HTML file that is immediately usable in a browser.
Operate offline with no external APIs, hosted generation, CDNs, remote fonts, scripts, stylesheets, or fragile dependencies.
Avoid unsafe HTML sinks, eval-like execution, inline event handlers, modal dialogs, and deprecated clipboard handling.
Avoid page-level horizontal overflow at 390 by 844 and at desktop width.
Keep essential controls visible, keyboard or touch reachable, and truthful about their current state.
Preserve exact prompt, response, source, and artifact-version evidence for the run.
contract.adaptiveRepairPolicy: Preserve and score the first real artifact. Continue only when verification proves a concrete defect or a source-capture failure; use the same source session and model; name the observed defect in ordinary language; preserve every real artifact version; stop as soon as the artifact passes; prefer no more than three total prompts and go beyond three only for a documented concrete lane reason such as a verification-proven regression, truncation, or mechanical capture failure.

variants.modelSettings: Visible Claude model chip showed Sonnet 4.6 Max before prompts 1-4; Claude page also showed Fable 5 currently unavailable. No separate speed/thinking setting changed.

notes: The first artifact left Save disabled after every required current-session field was selected, so it could not create history or a usable receipt.
It also preserved scanner-visible deprecated clipboard wording and nonzero letter spacing that later source-session repairs removed.
The final enabled Save for a complete setup, created a persistent 100/100 session, covered privacy and retake checks, and generated a detailed receipt.
Static safety, 390px, desktop, and console checks passed.

variants.modelSettings: ChatGPT Work surface; Effort: Extra High; Speed: Standard.

notes: The first artifact rendered at desktop and true 390x844 with no page-level overflow or console errors, and its core studio workflow was present.
Static verification found prohibited window.print() and window.confirm() paths plus four negative letter-spacing declarations.
True-390 measurement found the first pose title and subtitle overlapping on one line with -13px vertical separation, producing labels such as Front relaxedNeutral stance.
Prompt-2 delivery remained byte-for-byte identical to prompt 1, so its claimed dialog repair was not accepted.
The final artifact passed all ten invariant acceptance checks, static safety and typography gates, script parsing, desktop workflow, and true 390x844 no-overflow verification.
A saved session produced a 100/100 receipt; baseline comparison reported 7 of 7 locked variables match; inline two-click clear retained then removed history as intended.
At true 390px the pose title/subtitle wrapper is a grid with a computed 4px gap and separate title/note nodes.
Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements showed zero overflow and zero console errors.
The response required image uploads and provided only four consistency checkboxes, omitting the contracted distance and timing controls and persistent session history.
Static verification found deprecated document.execCommand clipboard handling.
Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements reported zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors, and the complete static hard-gate scan passed.
Direct diff evidence showed the final repair changed exactly one safety-comment line and no executable behavior.
All four project-specific checks and all six shared production checks remain passed.
